profile.headline: Advanced Software Engineer at General Dynamics

positions.title: Scientific Software Developer
positions.insights: Python (Programming Language), C (Programming Language) and +5 skills

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
▪ Researching and interpreting existing ANN models
▪ Developing multiple ANN models to extract Compton Form Factors in the context of particle physics
▪ Utilizing TensorFlow to construct models to optimize Compton Form Factor extraction techniques
▪ Applying LabView to handle specific instrument capabilities
▪ Building and implementing LabVIEW framework for Keithley multimeter
▪ Developing code to satisfy with Delacor message handler software requirements
▪ Executing tests for multimeter to verify compatibilities 
▪ Performing baseline optimal fit for our working dataset

positions.title: Exoplanet Atmosphere Researcher
positions.description:
▪ Utilized FORTRAN to develop exoplanet simulation model
▪ Modeled the interaction of Lyman-alpha radiation in exoplanet atmospheres
▪ Studied Monte Carlo sampling and the ionization and resonant scattering phenomenon in atmospheres
▪ Optimized computer code to accelerate Monte Carlo radiation transfer for Lyman alpha resonance line 
scattering

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
▪ Investigated quenching effects of superconducting magnets
▪ Operated COMSOL multi-physics software to build cross section of superconducting magnet
▪ Conducted simulations of the magnet to reduce quenching effects
▪ Performed lab duties, refilling and maintaining cryogenic dewers
